description: spec/matching.md section 18 (MATCHING-DESIGN.md 4.7, 7.5, 7.6; O92): for each ranking case of matching-rank.json, the inputs a node agent's copy of the roll it ranks on holds, as PoxMatching and PoxMatchReader answer them on the Hardhat network at the case's read block (the request as requestInfo answers it with the resources and terms of the case, its rounds as roundAt answers them, the roll as rollPage answers it, every period of each roll node as periodAt answers it and its skip of the request's image as skipOf answers it), and the reader's answers on them: the list as candidates answers it in one read from the top of the roll (`read`) and, for a ranked request whose list read ends above the roll's end, on from its cursor with beyond set (`beyond`), and each roll node's turn as turnOf answers it in one page from the top of the roll. A port of the ranking rule that holds these inputs computes the same list words, list hash, matching count and turns. Times, slots and block numbers are those of the case (the replay's offsets taken off); the inputs are the replayed chain's, which differ from the case's where the replay does (a period that starts in the roll's slot after its entry's beat time starts at that beat time); round stamps are not given (matching-rank.json pins them).
